class Solution:
    def maxSumTrionic(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        i = 0
        ans = -inf
        while i < n:
            l = i
            i += 1
            while i < n and nums[i - 1] < nums[i]:
                i += 1
            if i == l + 1:
                continue

            p = i - 1
            s = nums[p - 1] + nums[p]
            while i < n and nums[i - 1] > nums[i]:
                s += nums[i]
                i += 1
            if i == p + 1 or i == n or nums[i - 1] == nums[i]:
                continue

            q = i - 1
            s += nums[i]
            i += 1
            mx = t = 0
            while i < n and nums[i - 1] < nums[i]:
                t += nums[i]
                i += 1
                mx = max(mx, t)
            s += mx

            mx = t = 0
            for j in range(p - 2, l - 1, -1):
                t += nums[j]
                mx = max(mx, t)
            s += mx

            ans = max(ans, s)
            i = q
        return ans
